title: Rep session
description: One logged rep. A full rep replays the person's own strategy steps in order with their driver submodalities, then the anchor step at the peak (D-reps-005). An anchor-only rep is the installed test. A sham logs only its rate steps. Installed is computed from these, never stored. Step indexes are checked against the profile by validateRepSession(). D-contracts-007.

repIndex.description: 0-based count of reps for this state, in order.

phase.description: Set on the reps logged from playbook section 4 (D-reps-006). Null otherwise.

detectionId.description: The DetectionEvent id. Required when kind is detection or manual from the detector.

arm.description: sham: the cue is withheld; the session still logs rate steps and recovery.

recoverySeconds.description: Seconds from the trigger until signals return to the peak band. Null when not measured.

recoveryCensored.description: True when the observation window ended before recovery.

anchorPaired.description: True when the anchor step was replayed at the peak of this rep (the conditioning pairing).

scriptHash.description: Hash of the generated rep script, so reps of the same script can be grouped.

kind.description: anchor-peak: the anchor step replayed at the end of a full rep. anchor: the anchor step alone, in an anchor-only rep.

stepIndex.description: Index into the state's strategy.steps. Required for strategy-step, anchor-peak and anchor.

driversSpoken.description: Indexes into the state's differences that were spoken as instructions in this step.
